steps.title: Euthanize and prep rat
steps.instruction: Euthanize the rat according to IACUC guidelines, spray the fur with ethanol, lift the skin above the sternum and cut through the skin and muscle layers without entering the chest cavity (do not cut above the diaphragm).

steps.title: Expose abdominal cavity
steps.instruction: Cut skin and muscles from the sternum down to the lower belly; after practice you can make a small precise cut on the left side of the belly to reach the spleen without extensive dissection.

steps.title: Locate and remove spleen
steps.instruction: Lift the liver lobes, push aside fat tissue and intestines to reveal the kidney and spleen; gently pull the spleen out of the specimen and trim off any attached fat.

steps.title: Place spleen in tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spleen into a pre‑labeled 2 mL microcentrifuge tube (e.g., Fisher Scientific cat#05‑408‑138); add approximately 0.5 mL saline solution ensuring the tube is not over‑filled; if the rat has an RFID chip, locate it and place it in the same tube; label the tube with a “Cryo Babies” laser‑printer label (Diversified Biotech cat# LCRY‑1700) that tolerates long‑term storage at –80 °C.

steps.title: Store tubes in boxes
steps.instruction: Place the labeled tubes into cardboard boxes that are clearly marked with the investigator’s name, project, tissue type, box number (if multiple boxes), and date (e.g., JHOU‑HSratsU01‑Spleen‑Box02_25Feb2019).

steps.title: Collect tail tip backup
steps.instruction: Cut off approximately 5 mm of the tail tip, put it into a 2 mL tube labeled with the barcode and rat ID, add saline to prevent desiccation, and store the tube at –80 °C for long‑term backup genotyping.

steps.title: Prepare shipping materials
steps.instruction: Gather at least 10 kg (20 lb) of dry ice for shipping (pellets preferred; if using slabs, ensure there is no free space in the shipping box so slabs cannot move freely); use a Styrofoam box surrounded by a thick‑walled cardboard box, such as ULINE S‑13392 or ULINE S‑11357.

steps.title: Ship samples and notify
steps.instruction: Ship the packed boxes via FedEx overnight on Monday or Tuesday (check for holidays); email the receiving lab beforehand so they are ready; send a list of the shipped samples (RFID IDs) for database updating.
